meta.title: Anchit Mulye — Senior ML Systems Engineer
meta.description: Senior ML Systems Engineer specialising in EdgeAI, ML Compilers, ONNX, and model compression for edge hardware.

hero.name: Anchit Mulye
hero.tagline: Building the systems that make AI run faster, smaller, and smarter — at the edge.

bio: I'm a Senior ML Systems Engineer focused on making AI models run efficiently on edge hardware — from server GPUs to edge devices.
I bridge the gap between research and production by transforming heavy models into fast, lightweight, edge-deployable AI. Specialised in ONNX, hardware-aware NAS, and NPU optimisation.
3 publications, 35+ citations, and open-source EdgeAI tooling.

experience.description: Led real-time AI features for JioMeet — noise suppression, speech translation and transcription across 5 Indian languages, generative-AI virtual backgrounds, and the C++ WebRTC media engine (Linux/Android).
Built real-time data visualisation for an embedded healthcare device without GPU acceleration. Won the All-India AI Hackathon with a face and voice authentication system.
Designed and implemented predictive analytics dashboards on Salesforce Einstein.
Researched semantic segmentation of satellite imagery using deep-learning models on a supercomputer. Presented at the All India ISRO Conference.

education.description: Postgraduate specialisation in Artificial Intelligence at IIT Jodhpur, one of India's premier technology institutes.
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science and Engineering.

projects.name: H3DNAS
projects.description: Source-code-free NAS that compresses 3D point-cloud models directly on ONNX graphs. Achieves up to 65% parameter reduction and 1.99x speedup on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano — no access to original training code required.

projects.name: naskit
projects.description: An open-source NAS toolkit providing reusable building blocks for neural architecture search research and experimentation.

projects.name: C++ ML Framework
projects.description: A header-only C++ framework implementing core machine learning training and inference functionality — designed for embedded and resource-constrained environments.
